Dutch DJ/producer Timmo Hendriks, known for his signature melodic progressive house style, signed a record deal with Nicky Romero’s Protocol Recordings back in 2018. After making his debut on the label with "In My Head," Hendriks promptly followed up with "Thinking About You", which has currently garnered over 3.5M streams on Spotify alone.

His next releases, such as "Magical" with Lindequist, "By Your Side" with Jordan Grace, or "Be Alright" with Marc Benjamin, continued to show increased energy and a more mature production style, which resulted in more great collaborations such as "Into The Light" with Nicky Romero, "Keep Me Close" with Dash Berlin, "Hold Me Down" with Marc Benjamin, "Remember" with Stadiumx, along with solo single "Something To Believe In" and 3-track debut artist EP "Follow You."

Besides producing music, Hendriks has performed live across the world at for example the Melkweg and Escape in Amsterdam as well as the Ministry Of Sounds in London and a six-city tour in India. With lots of music in the pipeline, 2022 marks another year to keep Timmo Hendriks on your radar!

When you think of Primeshock, you think of pure energy, explosive power, and unstoppable entertainment! This Dutch Hardstyle duo, consisting of Bart Peters & Thijs Verdegaal, is electrifying the scene with an unstoppable shockwave of high-energy, insane crowd interaction, and a signature uplifting sound.

Known for their crazy DJ performances, Primeshock redefines what it means to party! Praised for honoring the old and celebrating the new, they blend classics hits with fresh bangers, creating a rollercoaster of fun, nostalgia, and innovation. With their catchy, feel-good, and motivational tracks, they ignite dancefloors worldwide. Their Powermode Podcast is proof that they don’t just play Hardstyle: They live and breathe it. 

From festivals like Defqon.1, Mysteryland, Intents Festival, Sziget, Reverze, Electric Love Festival, and Tomorrowland to legendary clubs like Bootshaus and Fabrik Madrid, Primeshock has dominated the biggest stages, backed by support from Hardstyle’s elite names like Headhunterz, Wildstylez, Coone, and Brennan Heart. With multi-million streaming hits like Fitness Move (with Villain), Use Somebody (with Tony Junior), and Glitchfest (with Da Tweekaz), they’ve cemented themselves at the top of the game.

In 2025, Primeshock is leveling up with their first-ever album, LIFEH4CK! More than just a collection of tracks, this album is an all-out experience, complete with a vlog series taking fans behind the scenes of the creative process. LIFEH4CK is built around four chapters: CTRL (Lose Control), ALT (Alter Your Mind), DEL (Take The Lead), and ESC (Escape), each representing a different way to let go, embrace the moment, and feel the energy that Hardstyle brings. Primeshock's LIFEH4CK proves that Hardstyle isn’t just music; it’s the ultimate lifehack to feeling good!

user.description:
LES BISOUS is a French DJ duo made up of Rodolphe and Julien. Their meeting in a club marked
the beginning of a friendship and a shared passion for Disco-House, with Italo-disco and funk
influences.
Spotted thanks to their remixes on social networks, they attract the attention of Dimitri Vegas &
Like Mike and sign a single on Smash Records. In 2020, they release *Everybody Dancing*,
followed by a remix of *Shine On Me* (Praise Cats) on Subliminal Records, a classic with over 17
million streams. Their collaboration with Ultra Naté, *Dangerous (Dare Me)*, quickly reached the
top 5 of the Armada charts, paving the way for new projects with international DJs.
Renowned for their highly acclaimed mixes and remixes (totalling millions of listens), LES BISOUS
are followed by artists such as Bob Sinclar, The Avener and The Shapeshifters, as well as radio
stations such as Radio FG and Fun Radio. In demand by numerous labels and artists, they
continue to impose their signature sound on the international electronic scene.
